Clear out enemies with fatal stabs, whirlwind slashes, and throwing knives!|Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Assassin''' is an intermediate melee ground tower that can be purchased from the store for {{Coins|800}}. The '''Assassin''' will slash at enemies within range with its knife, dealing high single-target damage. At Level 2+, it gains the ''Whirlwind Slash'', turning its every third hit into a whirlwind that pierces through every enemy caught in it. The whirlwind replaces the main attack, dealing the main attack's damage in its own whirlwind range. At Level 4, it gains an additional ability, ''Fan of Knives'', where it will throw out three knives which travel beyond the tower's range in a fan shape at enemies every time a meter of 500 total damage is hit, being able to pierce through three enemies per knife. Both the main attack and ''Whirlwind Slash'' can be used to increase the damage threshold, but not the ''Fan of Knives''. If the damage dealt exceeds the threshold, any excess damage will be carried over to the next counter. For example, if the '''Assassin''' deals 60 damage and has a threshold of 460, it will start throwing knives after dealing 520 damage. The additional 20 damage will carry over to the next throw, meaning the counter seen on the tower will start at 20/500. The '''Assassin''' has [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] and [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 2. [[Mission Quests|Mission Quest]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Assassin''' can be an effective early-game tower, due to its cheap cost, decent AoE and DPS. **The '''Assassin''' can hit [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] enemies quite early on, making it excellent for gamemodes where such enemy types appear quite early, like the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **At the beginning, it is recommended to place down two Level 0 '''Assassins''', which should be upgraded to Level 2 once the cash is available. **Later on, it is recommended to fully upgrade '''Assassins''', as lower levels will struggle to handle higher health enemies like the [[Molten Golem]] or [[Fallen Giant]]. ** The '''Assassin''' can be used to quickly clear earlier waves and essentially speedrun early game, especially with its '''Whirlwind Slash''' which allows it to attack multiple enemies at once. *While it can become ineffective during late-game, It can shred or decrease hordes of lower-health enemies like [[Hazmat]] or [[Breaker4]], allowing other towers to target the stronger enemies on the lane. ** The '''Assassin''' is especially useful in taking out weaker hordes of [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] enemies as many other towers cannot attack this enemy type, allowing them to focus on the enemies they can damage. *Due to the '''Assassin's''' low range, it is quite important to maximize how much path it can cover. Poor placement will lead to it performing poorly. **Ideal spots for it are small bends, like the multiple u-turns on [[U-Turn]] or the u-turn at the beginning of [[Simplicity]]. Other decent options are spots which enemies cross over multiple times, such as the center of [[Crossroads]] or one of two loops of [[Northern Lights]]. *By late-game, the '''Assassin''' will be unable to fight off the far stronger enemies. It is recommended to invest in far better towers by then. ** '''Assassin''' can still be used to clear crowds, especially when many are placed down. *The '''Assassin''' benefits greatly from the [[Firerate Buff]] and [[Damage Buff]]. **The [[Firerate Buff]] makes it attack faster, reaching its three hit and 500 damage thresholds quicker and increasing its DPS. **The [[Damage Buff]] not only boosts the damage from the main attack, but also the damage of the whirlwind and the knife throw, boosting the DPS of all of its three attacks. **The [[Range Buff]] is not that effective on the '''Assassin''', as it only boosts its main attack range. The ''Whirlwind Slash'' and ''Fan of Knives'' abilities will not have their range boosted by it. *The '''Assassin''' synergises well with the [[Firework Technician]] as it has AOE attacks that can launch a high amount of fireworks from hitting multiple enemies at once. **Do note that the '''Assassin''' only starts performing AOE attacks from Level 2 onward with its ''Whirlwind Slash''. This means that using the [[Firework Technician]] to boost a Level 0-2 '''Assassin''' is not as effective since those levels only use basic, single-target attacks. *The '''Assassin''' can indirectly hit [[Flying]] enemies with its ''Whirlwind Slash'' and ''Fan Of Knives'' if another detectable enemy is within attacking range. **This means that '''Assassin''' is technically able to damage all three enemy types, though it is not recommended to rely on this for [[Flying]] enemies. ==Trivia== *The '''Assassin''' is the second left-handed tower in the game, with the first being the [[Harvester]]. **All other towers are either right handed or use both of their hands from Level 0. *In the official trailer for the '''Assassin''' before its release, it was misspelled as '''Assasin''' due to an oversight. *The '''Assassin's''' Level 4 upgrade name is a reference to a member of the balancing team named Tom Da Ninja. **The acronym for "''Death Arms''" is DA, so the upgrade name Death Arms Ninja also spells out DA Ninja, as in Tom Da Ninja. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''6 August 2025''' - [[v1.72.0]] **'''Assassin''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Assassin''' does not attack flying enemies when given flying detection. **{{Bug}} Damage added to the damage threshold is always the same as the base damage value times number of enemies hit, regardless of how much damage the tower actually deals.
